newsitem.title: USA: Saks to issue notes, offer 8 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Saks to issue notes, offer 8 mln shrs.

text.p: Saks Holdings Inc, the parent company for Saks Fifth Avenue, said Thursday it filed a registration statement to offer eight million common shares and $200 million in convertible subordinated notes due 2006.
The eight million shares will be sold by certain stockholders, who will receive all of the proceeds of the secondary stock offering, Saks said.
The underwriters have an over-allotment option to purchase an additional 1.2 million shares from the selling stockholders, Saks said.
The company is not participating in the stock offering, but will use the proceeds from the sale of the $200 million in notes to reduce debt and for general corporate purposes.
Goldman Sachs & Co is the book running manager for each offering, while Goldman Sachs, CS First Boston, Morgan Stanley & Co Inc and Salomon Brothers Inc are co-lead managers, the company said.
